0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000010_PIPIN
0.description: Pray join me in welcoming our Scion allies, but recently returned from their mission to the Far East. We have been most eager to hear a firsthand account of your time there, eventful as we understand it was.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000030_RAUBAHN
2.description: ...Such victories are rarely won without sacrifice. But the prize is worth the price. Doma free, after all these years.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000040_CONRAD
3.description: Bloody hells... Flooding their own castle for a better chance at victory...<hex:02100103>We could learn a thing or two from that lad.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000050_PIPIN
4.description: Our agents report a flurry of communications between Garlemald and Ala Mhigo in recent days. 'Tis plain they are in the midst of deliberating their response to the Doman uprising.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000060_RAUBAHN
5.description: Good. Every imperial unit in occupied territory will be on the lookout for civil unrest. The fear of leaving critical locations undefended will make commanders think twice about committing their forces─giving us a chance to seize the initiative.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000070_CONRAD
6.description: We have a chance, aye─mayhap the last one we're ever gonna get.<hex:02100103>While we've done our best to rebuild the Resistance, the imperials have only increased their efforts to root out sympathizers.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000080_CONRAD
7.description: If we keep on playing for smaller prizes, it's only a matter of time before they crush us again. And that we won't come back from.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000090_PIPIN
8.description: A swift advance seems best for all concerned. Not least poor Mistress Krile.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000100_RAUBAHN
9.description: Then let us waste no more time.<hex:02100103>The campaign for Ala Mhigan liberation begins now!

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000110_RAUBAHN
10.description: Our first objective will be to capture Castellum Velodyna. Take the bridge,<hex:02100103>and the whole of the Fringes will be ours. From there, we can push east<hex:02100103>towards the Peaks.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000120_RAUBAHN
11.description: I name this operation Rhalgr's Beacon. For as Rhalgr once sent His star to guide our ancestors to these lands, so too shall it see us home!

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000140_MNAAGO
13.description: Good. It's the waiting that drives me mad. Standing around, knowing what's to come. I'll never get used to it.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000150_LYSE
14.description: Calm down, Naago. You're making her nervous.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000160_LYSE
15.description: We've come this far, haven't we? We just need to make it the rest of the way!

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000180_CONRAD
17.description: Looks like the bastards went for the bait. The bridge is ours for the taking!

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000190_CONRAD
18.description: Now remember, M'naago: I want you to make for the tower as soon as you see an opening and get that flag flying. We'll see to the fighting.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000200_MNAAGO
19.description: I won't let you down, sir!

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000210_CONRAD
20.description: Come, then! Rhalgr's star shall burn bright this day!

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000230_LYSE
22.description: No more running. No more hiding. Let's finish this!

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000250_CONRAD
24.description: The bridge is ours! Ala Mhigo, Ala Mhigo, Ala Mhigo!

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000280_FORDOLA
27.description: Stand your ground! It's not over yet!

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000290_RAUBAHN
29.description: Hark you, brothers and sisters! The bridge is ours!

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000310_RAUBAHN
31.description: We have them on the run! Forward! No mercy!

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000320_G3F1IMPERIALCENTURION
32.description: Regroup, regroup... We have to regroup! All units─ Fall back!

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000330_SKULLSOLDIERC
33.description: Commander! The 4th Cohort has been routed! We'll be at the mercy of the enemy's reinforcements if we don't fall back now!

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000340_FORDOLA
34.description: Idiot! We have the stronger force by far! Don't be taken in by their tricks!<hex:02100103>Or would you rather tell Zenos you lost to this rabble!?

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000350_SKULLSOLDIERC
35.description: No, but if the snakes betray us in the confusion, we'll have no way out!<hex:02100103>I'm begging you, Commander─give the order, or we'll all die here!

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000360_FORDOLA
36.description: ...As common traitors who drank of muddied waters. For all the good it did us.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000370_FORDOLA
37.description: Skulls, with me! The day is theirs, and so is this bastard bridge.<hex:02100103>Someone bring the snake!

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000390_CONRAD
39.description: Let them go, Lyse! We've done what we came here to do.<hex:02100103>That's enough for now.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000400_LYSE
40.description: ...I suppose. It's our first victory, isn't it? And that has to be worth something.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000410_MNAAGO
41.description: Ah, you've come. Welcome, friends, to my village. My home.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000430_MNAAGO
43.description: Good, all things considered. Better than the Ananta, at any rate...<hex:02100103>They've sent an emissary. I'll take you to her.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000440_LYSE
44.description: We're here to help. Will you tell us what happened?

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000450_VIRASOLDIER
45.description: Aye. It began with a quarrel between the imperials and the Qalyana.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000460_MNAAGO
46.description: The Qalyana are another Ananta tribe─the strongest and the most influential.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000470_MNAAGO
47.description: Unlike the Vira, they want no part of our troubles. They swore fealty to the Empire and were content to remain within their borders.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000480_VIRASOLDIER
48.description: Jussst ssso. The Qalyana forsssook their pride and the fight, and yielded to Garlemald long ago.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000490_VIRASOLDIER
49.description: But then a new commander was sssent to hold the black bridge.<hex:02100103>She demanded the Qalyana sssurrender a hossstage, thisss Butcher.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000500_LYSE
50.description: Fordola. It doesn't make sense, though... The Vira are the ones working with the Resistance. Why would she threaten the Qalyana?

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000510_VIRASOLDIER
51.description: Because she is ignorant, like all imperials. She knows not the difference between Qalyana and Vira, nor does she care to learn.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000520_ALPHINAUD
52.description: I see. All Fordola knew for sure was that the Resistance would come from<hex:02100103>the west. She reasoned, therefore, that if the Ananta on the east bank turned their coats, she would be trapped. I take it the Qalyana had no choice but<hex:02100103>to oblige her.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000530_VIRASOLDIER
53.description: No, they did not. The imperials left with the Qalyana broodmother's own daughter, Anamika.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000540_VIRASOLDIER
54.description: Long days and nightsss she looked out on the black bridge, weeping for her child. Until you came.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000550_VIRASOLDIER
55.description: The broodmother knew at once which way the winds would blow. She and her warriors met with the fleeing imperials in the road and demanded that her daughter be returned.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000560_LYSE
56.description: Bad idea... Fordola's not the kind to take threats lying down.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000570_VIRASOLDIER
57.description: You know her well. The Butcher turned her blade to Anamika and bade the Qalyana move aside.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000580_VIRASOLDIER
58.description: But the broodmother would not yield.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000590_ALISAIE
59.description: I know where this is going...

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000600_VIRASOLDIER
60.description: The Qalyana sssurrounded the imperials, one of whom, whether out of fear or ssstupidity, cut the child down. There was naught that could be done.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000620_VIRASOLDIER
62.description: The true madnesss was yet to come. For in her dessspair, the Qalyana broodmother cried out for her daughter to be ressstored to life.<hex:02100103>She bessseeched Sri Lakshmi's intercession.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000630_ALPHINAUD
63.description: She summoned a primal, then and there?

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000640_VIRASOLDIER
64.description: That she did, if only for an inssstant. Bereft of courage and honor,<hex:02100103>the broodmother sssought sssolace in her faith.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000650_VIRASOLDIER
65.description: The imperials fled in terror at the sssight of the goddesss, abandoning these lands to the Ananta...

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000660_VIRASOLDIER
66.description: Now the Qalyana bid usss make pilgrimage, to pay proper ressspectsss.<hex:02100103>Yet though we Vira revere Sri Lakshmi as the holiessst of the holy, we will not prossstrate ourssselves before Her.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000670_ALISAIE
67.description: And so you turned to us.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000680_VIRASOLDIER
68.description: Aye. All who have fought with the Resissstance have heard tell of the warrior. The eikon-ssslayer.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000690_ALPHINAUD
69.description: I believe we have heard enough. Inconvenient though the timing may be, if a primal has indeed been summoned, we can scarce afford to ignore it.<hex:02100103>We must needs discuss how best to resolve this situation.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000700_QALYANAPATRIARCH
70.description: Why, Missstresss... Why does my Anamika ssslumber ssstill?

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000710_LAKSHMI
71.description: Look thee on her face, sssupplicant. Thy prayer hath been anssswered.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000720_LAKSHMI
72.description: Flesh sssundered hath been made whole. Blood ssspilt runneth through her veins. Breath ssstolen filleth her breassst.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000730_QALYANAPATRIARCH
73.description: But she hears not her mother's words, nor sssees her mother's face!<hex:02100103>She...she is sssilent...and empty...

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000740_LAKSHMI
74.description: Only the vesssel may be remade. Not so the flame which flickered within.<hex:02100103>Her soul hath been scattered to the four winds.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000750_ALISAIE
75.description: Now do you see her promises for what they are!?

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000770_ALISAIE
77.description: Mayhap I have! But I refuse to stand by and watch yet another tragedy unfold!

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000780_QALYANAPATRIARCH
78.description: Who intrudes upon thisss sssacred ground!? Imperials thirsssting for blood!?

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000790_ALISAIE
79.description: No! We come not to shed blood but to save you from the false god who would lead you astray!

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000800_ALISAIE
80.description: I understand how you feel, I do. You loved her with all your heart, but when the moment came, you still couldn't save her. The anguish, the anger...<hex:02100103>I know it only too well.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000810_ALISAIE
81.description: But I also know where this path leads! To embrace a primal is to condemn yourself to an endless cycle of despair. You will never know peace!

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000820_LAKSHMI
82.description: A worm-eaten heart may find peace and ssserenity in ssservice. In beauty and grace. Thisss hath ever been my promissse. Naught elssse.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000830_ALISAIE
83.description: You tempt them with visions of things that can never be, and leave them bereft and wanting!

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000840_ALISAIE
84.description: No illusion, however sweet, can change the fact that your daughter is gone. Remember her as she was! Do not suffer this piteous shade to tarnish her memory!

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000850_LYSE
85.description: For every prayer that primal “answers,” it'll demand payment in kind. Do you have any idea how many more Ananta will die to feed its hunger for crystals!?

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000860_LAKSHMI
86.description: They would have thee sssuffer man's ssspite and live in fear. Far better to dwell in my beauteousss dream than endure ssso ugly a reality.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000870_LYSE
87.description: She's wrong! We hate the Empire as much as you! If you'd just listen─

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000880_LAKSHMI
88.description: Poor, misssguided children. I would ssspare you the tormentsss of thisss cruel and misshapen world. Come, basssk in my radiance. Let it fill your heartsss and free you from your burdens.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000900_LAKSHMI
90.description: Abide in misery then, fools. The Ananta are more deserving of my blesssing...

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000910_LAKSHMI
91.description: Leave these lands and my dreamers be. I will not warn you a second time.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000920_LYSE
92.description: You did it again. You saved them. I just wish I could've been more help...

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000930_LYSE
93.description: So...it looks like the Ananta did have a mountain of crystals after all.<hex:02100103>Like every other tribe. Gods, we're all such slaves to our weaknesses...

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000940_QALYANAPATRIARCH
94.description: You! You ssslew our Missstresss! She was our hope, our sssalvation!<hex:02100103>Is there no end to your cruelty!?

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000950_LYSE
95.description: Listen to me, please! I know that you're only trying to protect yourselves because you feel frightened and alone...

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000960_LYSE
96.description: But that's how we all feel, don't you see? If we could just turn to each other for help instead of the gods, I'm sure we could find a way to live in peace!

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000970_LYSE
97.description: Your crystals are important to you, aren't they? Reflections of your souls, right? Well, you shouldn't have to sacrifice something so precious to a primal...

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000980_QALYANAPATRIARCH
98.description: Who are you to quessstion our choice? You who fight without fear? We wish only to live in peace, and if thisss be the price we must pay, then ssso be it!

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_000990_LYSE
99.description: I know there's nothing I can say to convince you. But I hope that one day you look back and see we only ever wanted the same thing.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001000_QALYANAPATRIARCH
100.description: Begone, damn you! Ssspare me your hollow words and leave me to mourn.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001010_LYSE
101.description: I'll go...but it doesn't mean I'm giving up.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001020_LYSE
102.description: Gyr Abania is our home too, and one way or another, we're going to have to learn to live together.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001030_LYSE
103.description: Come on. Alphinaud and Alisaie are waiting.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001039_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
104.description: Meanwhile, in the Royal Palace of Ala Mhigo...

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001040_GARLEANLEADERA
105.description: (-Imperial Tribunus Militum-)Ah, the savage returns. And with her tail firmly between her legs.<hex:02100103>Beaten by beastmen, I hear.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001050_GARLEANLEADERC
106.description: (-Imperial Pilus Prior-)'Twas a shameful display, by all accounts. She may have curried the viceroy's favor with her bold promises, but in the end, she's just another plodding bungler like the rest of her kind.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001060_GARLEANLEADERA
107.description: (-Imperial Tribunus Militum-)Strange, you would think him a better judge of character. Then again, I hear she's not averse to a more physical mode of persuasion.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001070_GARLEANLEADERC
108.description: (-Imperial Pilus Prior-)Hah, I thought she rose through the ranks rather quickly. But no longer. If only she had been content with her lot, she might have lived to see the morrow.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001080_FORDOLA
109.description: Fordola rem Lupis, commander of the Crania Lupi, reporting as ordered.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001100_ZENOS
111.description: Could it be that the Empire's Butcher is afraid? That she who walks with death is terrified of her own?

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001110_FORDOLA
112.description: I am terrified of dying having achieved naught. Gladly would I give my life to win a great victory on the battlefield, had I but the strength.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001120_ZENOS
113.description: Alas, you do not. Indeed, you are weak. And born of this weakness is a blind fervor. A raging inferno which threatens to consume not only you, but everyone around you.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001140_ZENOS
115.description: You were defeated by the Resistance on several occasions.<hex:02100103>You misjudged the Ananta and spurred them into summoning an eikon.<hex:02100103>Have you anything to say?

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001150_FORDOLA
116.description: I do not, my lord. My failures are my own.<hex:02100103>I am prepared to accept your judgment.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001160_ZENOS
117.description: And that is very admirable. However, I've had enough of this dumb show. Give voice to that hunger I see in your eyes, or I will pluck them from your head.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001180_FORDOLA
119.description: I want to make them pay! All of them! Everyone who ever mocked or looked down on me─I want the power to make them pay!

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001200_ZENOS
121.description: Then I shall give you a chance. A chance to transcend your mortal limits. Assuming, that is, you are prepared to wager your life for such power.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001220_FORDOLA
123.description: I came here prepared to die. Tell me what I must do.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001230_LYSENARRATION
124.description: I remember how they laughed. Alliance and Resistance soldiers,<hex:02100103>eager for battle, trading jokes as we marched east towards the Peaks...

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001240_LYSENARRATION
125.description: Beyond this last line of defenses lay the Lochs and the city. Breaching it would be no small feat.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001250_LYSENARRATION
126.description: But we beat the imperials back, just like that, and we liberated a village. The first of many...

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001259_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
127.description: Meanwhile, deep within an imperial research facility...

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001280_ZENOS
130.description: So...she lives. Impressive...or merely lucky.<hex:02100103>Though that too may prove a useful trait.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001290_FORDOLA
131.description: My lord...what have you done to me...?

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001300_DRUSUS
132.description: Though we Garleans are intellectually and physiologically superior in almost all respects, we lack the hereditary traits required for the reliable manipulation of aether─hence our unique inability to wield magicks.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001310_DRUSUS
133.description: This deficiency, for want of a better word, saw us subjected to decades of oppression by the lesser races, and we were eventually driven to seek shelter in the cold northern reaches of Ilsabard.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001320_DRUSUS
134.description: Fortunately, said region was replete with vast deposits of ceruleum, which proved instrumental in the development of magitek: a revolutionary technology conceived to compensate for our disadvantage.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001330_DRUSUS
135.description: It was with magitek that we grew strong─that our nation became an empire. Yet ultimately, this was an extrinsic solution to an intrinsic problem. What I wanted was not a crude device to be used in lieu of magic.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001340_DRUSUS
136.description: Through modification of the Garlean genome, I argued that it might be possible to enhance a subject's ability to manipulate aether, effectively empowering them to wield magicks. Alas, my theories were met with consternation in the imperial court.<hex:02100103>Only Lord Zenos, with commendable foresight and wisdom, deigned to support my research.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001350_FORDOLA
137.description: ...You gave me this treatment? But I'm not Garlean.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001370_ZENOS
139.description: What you have been granted is far greater than mere magic. Before that lesser light, it is as a second sun.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001380_DRUSUS
140.description: I am informed that Ala Ghiri was recently occupied by the Resistance, and that an attack on Specula Imperatoris is considered imminent. This could provide an ideal opportunity to test her performance in the field.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001390_ZENOS
141.description: Your...Skulls, was it? They have joined the garrison at the watchtower?

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001400_FORDOLA
142.description: ...Yes, my lord. By your leave, I would rendezvous with them and lead a counterattack against the insurgents.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001410_ZENOS
143.description: No. Even were you to leave now, you would not arrive in time.<hex:02100103>There is another duty I would entrust to you...

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001440_PIPIN
146.description: Come now, Father. You lured the fool onto my blade, and do not try to deny it!

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001450_RAUBAHN
147.description: Our work here is all but done. What of Conrad and his men?

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001460_PIPIN
148.description: They are for the main tower. The Skulls have offered fierce resistance thus far, but Conrad seems to believe he can convince them to lay down their arms...

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001470_RAUBAHN
149.description: Then we will tend to the stragglers down below. With me!

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001490_GARLEANOFFICER
151.description: Enemy forces have overrun the lower facilities, and appear to be mounting an assault on the main tower. We have already received a request for reinforcements.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001500_GARLEANOFFICER
152.description: A unit of legionaries has been mustered and is ready to depart.<hex:02100103>They await your orders, Commander.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001540_GARLEANOFFICER
156.description: Commander, if I may! Our people─your people are still in there!<hex:02100103>They will be slaughtered!

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001550_FORDOLA
157.description: You think I don't know that!? I want nothing more than to help them─to lead the bloody charge─but I have my orders!

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001560_FORDOLA
158.description: Lord Zenos said no reinforcements. He would have us use the main cannon to destroy the installation.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001570_GARLEANOFFICER
159.description: What...kill our own soldiers!? You must be mistaken!

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001580_FORDOLA
160.description: Mayhap you'd like to ask Lord Zenos yourself?

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001590_FORDOLA
161.description: I thought not. Initiate the firing sequence.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001600_FORDOLA
162.description: Wars are won on the backs of the dead. Theirs and ours. There is no truth but this. We must remain firm and resolute, and always, always do our duty.<hex:02100103>Now, give the order!

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001620_GARLEANHARPOONER
164.description: Aye, aye, initiating firing sequence!<hex:02100103>Release safety locks...deploy main cannon!

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001630_FORDOLA
165.description: Ansfrid, Hrudolf, Emelin...<hex:02100103>For us. For our people. For our future.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001640_GARLEANOFFICER
166.description: I need you to confirm the target, Commander.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001650_FORDOLA
167.description: Specula Imperatoris, main tower. Fire when ready.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001680_RAUBAHN
170.description: Those treacherous bastards... Their people were still fighting!<hex:02100103>Full retreat, now! Relay the orders!

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001700_PIPIN
172.description: All forces, retreat! I repeat: all forces, retreat!

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001720_ALPHINAUD
174.description: It...it was all so sudden. Conrad had just convinced the last few Skulls to surrender, when...when we heard the bang, and...and everything started to shake...

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001730_ALPHINAUD
175.description: We carried the survivors to safety, but Conrad is... We have done what we can for him. All that remains is to pray.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001760_CONRAD
178.description: Is...is that you, Lyse? Can't...can't see a damn thing...

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001770_CONRAD
179.description: Well, that's that, then. Time's up.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001780_LYSE
180.description: What are you talking about!? You'll be on your feet before you know it!

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001790_CONRAD
181.description: It's all right, Lyse. I've lived long enough. But listen... I want...I want you to lead the Resistance in my stead.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001800_LYSE
182.description: Don't say another word! You'll recover─we'll recover! We'll bring freedom to Ala Mhigo together! We're not going to stop here!

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001810_CONRAD
183.description: No...no, you won't. Everything we've built, everyone we've brought together...I know you'll show them the way...

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001820_CONRAD
184.description: You've got it in you, Lyse. Not because you're Curtis's daughter, or Yda's sister, but because...because you're you. Because you're you...

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001840_CONRAD
186.description: Lead them to victory. To freedom.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001850_LYSE
187.description: I will, Conrad. I will. I promise.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001859_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
188.description: Meanwhile, in the chaos of Castrum Abania...

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001890_G3F1IMPERIALCENTURION
192.description: Impossible! How can one man─ Shoot the bastard! Shoot him!

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001900_ESTINIEN
193.description: Heh. My lance has slain far greater beasts.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001920_G3F1IMPERIALCENTURION
195.description: Notify all units─I want that intruder found!<hex:02100103>And get the engineers to fix my bloody cannon!

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001950_ALISAIE
198.description: Ah...I think that answers my question.<hex:02100103>We have accomplished our objectives as well.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001960_ALPHINAUD
200.description: Lyse's unit should be advancing upon the fire control center in the command tower. Let us join them.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001970_ALPHINAUD
201.description: Lyse! Thank the Twelve you're all right.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_001980_LYSE
202.description: And you! There's the control center. Let's hit them hard and fast. Ready?

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002000_LYSE
204.description: It was you, wasn't it... Wasn't it!?

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002010_FORDOLA
205.description: Aye, I gave the order to fire.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002020_LYSE
206.description: It was over! The Skulls had surrendered! No one else had to die!<hex:02100103>And you killed them! Your own people! Your own comrades!

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002030_FORDOLA
207.description: You're right. I killed them. Ansfrid, Hrudolf, Emelin, all the rest─trained and fought with every last one of them. Good soldiers to a man.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002040_FORDOLA
208.description: I gave the order that led to their deaths...and I knew exactly what I was doing.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002050_LYSE
209.description: But why!? Why would you do that!?

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002060_FORDOLA
210.description: They died so that all Ala Mhigans could live free. That was all we ever wanted.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002070_FORDOLA
211.description: We made a promise that we would do whatever it took so that one day...one day the imperials would learn to accept us.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002080_FORDOLA
212.description: But everything comes at a price. And if you haven't got the means to pay, then you pay with blood.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002090_FORDOLA
213.description: Service guarantees citizenship, but citizenship guarantees naught. It's not enough to do your part, oh no. You have to run faster, fight harder, kill more and more and more─and only then will you be equal.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002100_FORDOLA
214.description: That's just how it is out here in the provinces. You buy your freedom with blood─there is no other way!

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002110_LYSE
215.description: Shut up! Shut your mouth! You don't get to talk about freedom!<hex:02100103>You killed your own! They trusted you and you killed them!

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002160_FORDOLA
220.description: I know what you can do. I've already seen it.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002180_FORDOLA
222.description: Even so, the odds are against me...

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002200_FORDOLA
224.description: Hero! Lord Zenos invites you to join him for the royal hunt, to be hosted at the palace. You may bring your horde, if you like. All are welcome.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002210_ALPHINAUD
225.description: She'll be all right, but we'll need to carry her. Will you help me?

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002220_ALPHINAUD
226.description: Thank you. Lyse, I leave matters here in your hands.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002240_RAUBAHN
228.description: I wanted to show you this house. My house.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002250_LYSE
229.description: You mean...this is where you grew up?

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002260_RAUBAHN
230.description: Aye. Not much to look at, is it?

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002270_RAUBAHN
231.description: Same could be said of the village. It was damn near impossible to live off<hex:02100103>the land, barren as it was─which is why so many of us traded our plowshares for swords.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002280_RAUBAHN
232.description: Swords and uniforms, mind. We became military men. Tensions were rising between Ala Mhigo and the Empire, and there was always a need for more soldiers to watch the border. 'Twas only a matter of time before the first skirmishes broke out.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002290_RAUBAHN
233.description: It is a frightening thing to face magitek armor for the first time. But after a lot of trial and error, I found ways to bring them down. After a few victories, people even said I had a knack for it.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002300_RAUBAHN
234.description: And then one day they hit us. Hard. I was wounded and sent home to recover. Back here...

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002310_CURTIS
235.description: Will you remain silent for fear of the mad king's vengeance? Of his eyes and ears in the shadows and his knives in the dark? You who call this “living” dishonor our nation─it is but a slow death!

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002320_CURTIS
236.description: Liberty or death. Liberty or death! If this be your creed, then raise up your hands! Raise up your voices! Together we will tear Theodoric from the throne! Together we will reclaim our freedom!

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002330_CURTIS
237.description: Sent you home to mend, did they?

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002340_RAUBAHN
238.description: Aye, sir. Garleans got the better of us. The...the chirurgeons say I'm healing well, so it won't be long now.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002350_CURTIS
239.description: Liberty or death, is it? Tell me, soldier: what do you think those words mean?

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002360_RAUBAHN
240.description: We...we must needs be willing to die for liberty?

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002370_CURTIS
241.description: Spoken like a true patriot. But liberty should not be the end in of itself.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002380_CURTIS
242.description: Liberty is the chance to build something better. A stronger, more prosperous home for our people. It's not quick or easy work, and it is never truly finished─but if you neglect it, then sooner or later, you look up to find you've traded one tyrant for another.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002390_RAUBAHN
243.description: Well, sir, I...I've never asked for much. Never wanted to live like a king─just wish it were a little bit easier is all. For me and everyone else. And I'm...I'm willing to die for that, if that's what it takes!

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002400_CURTIS
244.description: Dying is easy, soldier. Living is harder.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002410_CURTIS
245.description: Rest. Mend. Regain your strength. You'll need it in the days to come...and mayhap one day we will need it too.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002420_RAUBAHN
246.description: Conrad chose you as his successor, Lyse, and I will not gainsay his decision.<hex:02100103>I have but one question to ask.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002430_RAUBAHN
247.description: Liberty or death. Those were Curtis's words, and his creed. Will you swear by your father's creed before your comrades and the gods?

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002440_LYSE
248.description: Liberty or death... That's all you can hope for in war. Father understood that...and you want to know if I do too.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002450_LYSE
249.description: I swear to you, here and now:<hex:02100103>I will fight until the end, be it liberty or be it death.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002460_LYSE
250.description: But the freedom we win must be for every Ala Mhigan─even ones like Fordola, though they may hate us, and the Ananta, though they may fear us.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002470_LYSE
251.description: We'll fight and we'll talk and we'll find a way to make it work for all of us. Compared to all that, retaking our home will seem like the easy part.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002480_RAUBAHN
252.description: Hmm. A good oath. Then there is naught else to say.<hex:02100103>You are indeed your father's daughter...

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002490_LYSE
253.description: Sorry to have kept you waiting...

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002500_LYSE
254.description: Well, what do you think? I know it's a bit old-fashioned...but in a traditional sort of way. Yda wore it whenever she could...

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002510_LYSE
255.description: Not that I'm pretending to be her or anything! Not again. It's just...if this is the last battle we fight to free Ala Mhigo, then she ought to be a part of it.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002520_LYSE
260.description: It's nice of you to say so. Aaand a bit embarrassing. But mostly nice.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002530_LYSE
261.description: Oh, I know, right? All these stupid frills everywhere...

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002540_LYSE
262.description: Well don't just stand there gawping! If you don't like it, just say so!

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002550_LYSE
263.description: Anyway, the real reason I asked you here was to sneak in a warm-up before the final battle.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04005_002560_LYSE
264.description: There's this place I know where monks used to spar as part of their training. Care to join me?
